source_name: RSPO – Rejestr Szkół i Placówek Oświatowych (open API)
what_it_contains: Every registered school/educational institution in Poland incl. przedszkola (typ 'Przedszkole', 'Punkt przedszkolny', 'Zespół wychowania przedszkolnego'): name, RSPO id, REGON, address, phone, email, website, organ prowadzący (operator – reveals chains via shared operator), public/non-public status, number of pupils (uczniowie), director name in some records.
how_to_extract: Use the REST API (JSON-LD / Hydra): GET https://api-rspo.men.gov.pl/api/placowki?typ_podmiotu_id=<id>&page=N ; filter kategoria_uczniow / status_publicznosc='niepubliczna'. Group by 'organ_prowadzacy' (podmiot_prowadzacy nazwa + REGON) to find multi-site operators. Also bulk CSV export via the rspo.gov.pl UI ('Eksportuj').

source_name: Rejestr żłobków i klubów dziecięcych (Ministry of Family – empatia / rejestrzlobkow.mrips.gov.pl)
what_it_contains: All nurseries (żłobki), kids' clubs and day carers: operator (podmiot prowadzący), address, capacity (liczba miejsc), fees, contact phone/email, website.
how_to_extract: Open the register search, filter by województwo/gmina, export list; or query the public JSON endpoint used by the portal (inspect network calls) and join operators with RSPO organ prowadzący by REGON/NIP to identify combined nursery+preschool chains.

what_it_contains: Company officers (zarząd), shareholders, addresses, PKD 85.10.Z (wychowanie przedszkolne) codes.
how_to_extract: Search PKD 85.10.Z + name; use rejestr.io API for board members; CEIDG for sole-trader preschool owners.

url: https://rejstriky.msmt.cz/rejskol/ (open data: https://data.msmt.cz/ , dataset 'Rejstřík škol a školských zařízení')
what_it_contains: All mateřské školy (incl. soukromé/private and církevní): RED-IZO, IČO, zřizovatel (founder – reveals chains), address, capacity (kapacita), ředitel name, email, website, legal form.
how_to_extract: Download XML/CSV from data.msmt.cz or use the rejskol search with 'Druh: Mateřská škola' and 'Zřizovatel: soukromník/právnická osoba'; group by zřizovatel IČO to find multi-site operators; director is in field 'ředitel'.

what_it_contains: Registered 'dětské skupiny' (micro-nurseries/childcare groups, often run by private preschool brands): provider name, IČO, address, capacity.
how_to_extract: Filter by region, export; join provider IČO with MŠMT register.

source_name: Register škôl a školských zariadení (CVTI SR) / Sieť škôl (MŠVVaŠ)
what_it_contains: All materské školy incl. súkromné: EDUID, zriaďovateľ (founder), address, riaditeľ, email, phone, number of children (from štatistické výkazy).
how_to_extract: Open CVTI 'Register škôl' export (XLS) or the RIS portal; filter 'druh školy = Materská škola' and 'zriaďovateľ = súkromný'; group by zriaďovateľ IČO.

source_name: KIR – Köznevelési Információs Rendszer, intézménykereső (Oktatási Hivatal)
what_it_contains: All óvoda (kindergartens) with OM azonosító, fenntartó (maintainer – reveals private operators: 'egyéb', 'alapítvány', 'gazdasági társaság', 'egyházi'), address, vezető (head) name, email, phone, feladatellátási helyek (sites) and capacity.
how_to_extract: Use KIR intézménykereső with intézménytípus='óvoda' and fenntartó típus filters; export XLS from kirpub; group by fenntartó to find chains; 'vezető' field gives the director.

source_name: SIRENE open data (INSEE) – NAF 88.91A Accueil de jeunes enfants

what_it_contains: LRK lists every registered Dutch childcare location with operator (houder) name, address, capacity, GGD inspection reports; KVK gives company officers

what_it_contains: All French crèche companies (NAF 88.91A accueil de jeunes enfants), dirigeants, chiffre d'affaires, comptes annuels, group structure
how_to_extract: Filter NAF 8891A by revenue; Pappers gives dirigeants and CA free; SIRENE bulk CSV from data.gouv.fr; also 'monenfant.fr' lists every crèche with gestionnaire

what_it_contains: Official French directory of all crèches/EAJE with gestionnaire (operator), capacity, address
how_to_extract: Search by département; scrape or use data.caf.fr open datasets ('Établissements d'accueil du jeune enfant') to list sites per operator

what_it_contains: Norwegian company register API (roles/daglig leder) and the national kindergarten register with owner (eier), children, staff per barnehage
how_to_extract: Barnehagefakta API / Udir 'Barnehagefakta' open data lists all ~5,500 barnehager with eierform and eier; brreg API /enhetsregisteret/api/enheter?naeringskode=88.911 for operators and /roller for CEOs

what_it_contains: Swedish preschool (förskola) units with huvudman (operator), plus company officers and revenue
how_to_extract: Skolenhetsregistret API (open) filtered by skolform=Förskola; group by huvudman; Allabolag for VD, revenue per company (free basic)

what_it_contains: Danish company register with directors, ownership, accounts; private daginstitutioner
how_to_extract: Search branchekode 88.91.00; API access free with registration

what_it_contains: Finnish company register; private päiväkoti operators (Touhula, Pilke, Norlandia, Dibber)
how_to_extract: Search by name/TOL 88911; officers via avoindata.prh.fi API

source_name: KRS / CEIDG Poland + RSPO (Rejestr Szkół i Placówek Oświatowych)
what_it_contains: All Polish przedszkola and żłobki with organ prowadzący (operator); KRS for company boards (Dibber, Norlandia, KIDS&Co)
how_to_extract: RSPO open API/CSV filtered by typ=Przedszkole and niepubliczne; group by operator; KRS free search for zarząd

what_it_contains: Swiss commercial register (owners/GL) and the national childcare association member directory
how_to_extract: Zefix API free; kibesuisse 'Mitglieder' directory for Kita operators; cantonal Kita lists (e.g. Zurich 'Kita-Verzeichnis')

what_it_contains: Aggregated national datasets on childcare facilities and Eurostat childcare enrolment; links to national open registers
how_to_extract: Search 'kindergarten', 'childcare', 'crèche', 'kinderopvang'; download CSV per member state

what_it_contains: Every registered early-years provider in England with provider name, organisation/owner, address, places, inspection grade
how_to_extract: Download monthly Excel; group by 'Provider name' / 'Registered person' to rank groups (Busy Bees, Kids Planet, Bright Horizons, Partou UK, Grandir UK)

what_it_contains: All Irish early-years services with registered provider name and capacity
how_to_extract: Download county CSVs; group by provider (Giraffe/Busy Bees, Tigers, Links)

source_name: Nursery World Nursery Chains / Nursery Groups Report
what_it_contains: Annual league table of UK's largest nursery groups (site counts, ownership, MDs) and daily M&A news
how_to_extract: Read 'Nursery Groups Report 2026' article; free with registration; track 'acquires' news for warm outreach

what_it_contains: UK nursery leadership appointments, acquisitions, PE deals, vendor news

what_it_contains: UK childcare market sizing, top-30 operators, PE ownership

source_name: Christie & Co / Cattaneo / Lincoln / Clearwater deal pages
what_it_contains: Childcare M&A announcements naming buyers, sellers and site counts across UK/FR/NL
how_to_extract: Filter news by 'childcare'/'nursery'; each release names the acquiring group and often its MD

source_name: Fédération Française des Entreprises de Crèches (FFEC)
what_it_contains: French private crèche operator association: member list (Babilou, Grandir/LPCR, LMB, People&Baby and 100+ SMEs), sector studies
how_to_extract: Members page; annual 'Baromètre' PDF for market data

source_name: Branchevereniging Maatschappelijke Kinderopvang (BMK) and Brancheorganisatie Kinderopvang (BK) NL
what_it_contains: Dutch childcare employer associations with member lists (commercial and non-profit chains)
how_to_extract: Member directories on site; combine with LRK data

what_it_contains: UK sector bodies; NDNA publishes member nursery finder, surveys, policy briefings
how_to_extract: NDNA 'find a nursery' member search; conference sponsor/exhibitor lists to see incumbents

what_it_contains: Norwegian private kindergarten association (~2,000 members), tariff/finance data, member barnehage search

what_it_contains: Swedish independent school and preschool association member lists
how_to_extract: Member search by 'förskola'

source_name: Deutscher Kitaverband / VKMK / Bundesverband für Kindertagespflege (Germany)
what_it_contains: Association of free/private Kita operators in Germany, members include Kinderzentren Kunterbunt, educcare, Stepke, FRÖBEL etc.

what_it_contains: German Kita directory grouped by operator with site counts and contact info
how_to_extract: Browse Träger pages (e.g. KiKu Kinderzentren Kunterbunt gGmbH) and export lists

source_name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator (free trial) + LinkedIn company pages
what_it_contains: Decision makers by title at each group (CEO, COO, CDO, Country MD, Head of Digital, Head of Parent Experience)

what_it_contains: Business listings with type 'child_care_agency'/'preschool', phone, website, ratings

what_it_contains: German/Austrian/Swiss/UK company officers, register changes, group trees (e.g. Babilou Family Deutschland, AcadeMedia PreSchools GmbH)

source_name: Registro Estatal de Centros Docentes no Universitarios (RCD) - Ministerio de Educación

source_name: Comunidad de Madrid - Buscador de centros educativos
what_it_contains: Madrid region schools incl. private 0-3 escuelas infantiles with address, phone, email, titular and website.

source_name: Ayuntamiento de Madrid open data - Escuelas infantiles municipales: empresas gestoras
what_it_contains: List of municipal escuelas infantiles in Madrid city with the private company/cooperative managing each under concession.
how_to_extract: Download CSV/XLS; pivot by 'empresa gestora' to rank concession operators (Clece/Koala, Arasti Barca, Suara etc.) and count centres per operator.

source_name: Generalitat de Catalunya - Mapa escolar / Cercador de centres educatius
what_it_contains: All Catalan llars d'infants / escoles bressol (public and private) with codes, addresses, titularity.

source_name: Junta de Andalucía - Centros de infantil 0-3 años (Agencia Pública Andaluza de Educación)

source_name: DGEEC - Direção-Geral de Estatísticas da Educação e Ciência (Rede escolar / Estatísticas da Educação)

what_it_contains: Registered day-care centres for 0-4 (public, community, private).
